intent: Handed off Draft PR #4374; AC-3 has an open second cause reported to the PM
progress_summary: Re-scoped PR #4374 after develop landed #4406 (the same off-loop projection design, written independently). Took develop's implementation and reduced this branch to the delta: (1) 8 lifecycle broadcasts now replay the cached rail and defer the authoritative rebuild to #4406's queue (RED/GREEN proven); (2) the worktree reconcile moved from the GUI event loop into the ingest worker, removing a measured 3225ms loop block; (3) cleared develop's clippy 1.95 collapsible_match break, needed because this diff modifies the same bin target (#4474's scope otherwise). Headed Chromium, isolated HOME, both themes: close-to-list 3.0-8.9ms against a 400ms budget; max event loop block 3225ms -> 554ms. A control build with the deferral removed fails the same spec. Left as Draft on purpose: when both Playwright projects run in one invocation the second sees a 16s list_windows silence with the GUI event loop idle and background Work scans spawning git children - a second, distinct cause of the same symptom, reported on the Board for the PM to register. verify.run has no record (host lease held, 5+ waiters, full 1500s budget spent, deferred).
